items.name: Clamdrinc

items.name: Captain's Lucky Hat
items.description:
This stylish hat gives the wearer a sense of confident authority and naval competence.  While aboard any sea going or flying vessel, if the wearer is the recognized captain, once per day when they issue a general order to the crew, all of their crew are affected by a @Compendium[pf1.spells.vqfrp8t0c1lw1jna]{Heroism} spell that lasts 1 hour per captain's level.

 

Just wearing the hat grants one a circumstance bonus to pursuasion skills with any who recognize that it is a captain's hat.

items.name: Heart of Greed
items.description:
Heart of Greed is a +3 keen mithral-alloy rapier that provides Critical Focus to the wielder if they have at least +6 base attack. 

If the wielder already has Improved Critical skill, the rapier casts Cure Light Wounds on a confirmed crit or Cure Moderate Wounds if the crit kills or downs an opponent of at least 5hd.
If the wielder achieves surprise by betraying an ally within melee combat and kills them, the weapon casts Remove Curse on the wielder at +10 caster level.

items.name: Bloodshot
items.description:
This weapon can be aimed with either firearm or wand proficiency, but it is technically a magic item and involves no technology. It radiates intense evil, was created through a heinous process that costs dozens of unwilling creatures their eternal souls, and has been wielded by the most destructive and terrifying entities known on Golarion for centuries. This evil has no direct effect on the wielder, it is believed.

items.name: Dorcroast
items.description: Dorcroast, the invigorating cold brew coffee inspired by the triumph over darkness in Ustalav, awakens your senses with a bittersweet symphony. With a delightful spritz of energy, Dorcroast revitalizes your day, infusing it with the indomitable spirit that arises from the genocide of one's enemies. items.name: Boots of Landing
items.description:
These boots allow the wearer to recover instantly from a fall and can absorb some damage from falling once per day.
The wearer lands on her feet no matter how far she falls,
and takes 2 fewer dice of damage from the fall than normal.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, catfall; Cost 500 gp

items.name: Demon's Sack
items.description:
Part of the Carriers by Calvin line of luxury containers, this finely crafted leather satchel has runework hidden in its stitching.
This dimensional pocket magically stores up to 50 cubic feet of items, and reduces their material-plane-weight by 69%.
